**Dead.**  The attack uses the tree group `Gamma_R/Lambda_v` generated by the
action on the horizontal tree.  Its vertex stabilizer is a residually finite
automaton group whose level quotients look arithmetic (orders
`6, 48, 192, 1536, ...`, with `(xz)^2` and `(xyz)^3` trivial).  The idea is to
build almost actions of `Gamma_R` from its finite level actions or from
truncated horizontal trees.

It is killed by `radu-horizontal-projection-kills-delta-squared`.  The mark
`(xz)^4` and the commutator `[y(xz)^2y, xz]` act trivially on the horizontal
tree, so every almost action pulled back from that quotient collapses the
mark.  Any positive construction must carry genuinely vertical monodromy on
the free kernel `Lambda_v`.
